name: ForumIssues
short: Turn Discord forum posts into GitHub issues
description: Each new post in a watched Discord forum becomes a GitHub issue (with labels and attachments) through a GitHub App. Messages that mention the bot become issue comments, issue comments that mention the App are posted back, and the poster is told when the issue is completed.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per server: watched forums and their repositories and labels; for each forum post, its title, the opening message's text, the poster's Discord user ID and username, and the linked GitHub issue; and messages waiting to be relayed between Discord and GitHub. Post text, usernames and IDs are copied to GitHub issues, which this cog cannot delete. A data deletion request stops the cog from mentioning that user.
install_msg: Thanks for installing ForumIssues! Run `[p]fi setup` for the GitHub App steps, then `[p]fi add #forum owner/repo [labels...]`. The bot needs the Message Content intent.
author: PacNPal
